summary: Edgewise Therapeutics announced an asset purchase agreement to sell its sevasemten compound and related neuromuscular program assets to Servier Pharmaceuticals LLC and Les Laboratoires Servier for $1.55 billion in cash at closing, plus potential milestone payments: up to $200 million for U.S. marketing approval of sevasemten for Becker Muscular Dystrophy (depending on labelling), $600 million for Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy approval, and $300 million upon annual U.S. net sales exceeding $550 million. The board recommended the transaction, with customary representations and warranties backed by buyer-obtained representation and warranty insurance. Closing is subject to HSR antitrust clearance and other customary conditions. Watch for regulatory review timing and any competing bids for the asset.
